name: Speak with Dillinger
summary: In Brill, Austil de Mon sends fighters to Deathguard Dillinger for a hazardous mission in service of Lady Sylvanas. The order begins at the Gallows' End Tavern, where the warrior trainer directs able-bodied recruits to the west end of the village.

sections.title: A Summons to the Front
sections.body: At the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, warrior trainer Austil de Mon seeks fighters willing to serve the Dark Lady. When the Deathguards need capable hands, he sends untested recruits into the field. Deathguard Dillinger oversees security on Brill's western edge and has requested someone with martial skill for an urgent task.

sections.title: Testing the Faithful
sections.body: The Forsaken must constantly prove their martial dominance on Tirisfal Glades' front line. Near Brill's graveyard, Dillinger manages local incursions. Reporting to him tests your combat skill and loyalty to the newly forged Forsaken nation.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Austil de Mon, the warrior trainer at Brill's Gallows' End Tavern, identifies potential soldiers and sends them to aid Deathguard Dillinger.

faq.q: Where can Deathguard Dillinger be found?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger is stationed at Brill's western edge in Tirisfal Glades, near the graveyard entrance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of reporting to Dillinger?
faq.answer: Dillinger needs an able-bodied champion for a combat mission to defend Brill and prove their allegiance to the Forsaken cause.

faq.q: What assignment does Dillinger have prepared?
faq.answer: When you report to Deathguard Dillinger, he gives you the task of hunting down Ulag the Cleaver, a dangerous threat.

faq.q: Do other Horde races receive this order?
faq.answer: Any Horde warrior trusted by Undercity officials can take the assignment, though it is mainly designed to assess recruits' combat prowess as they defend Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does a warrior trainer send me to Dillinger?
faq.answer: Austil de Mon trains warriors at Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. He sends newly capable adventurers to Deathguard commanders who need immediate muscle.

angles.text: As a newly liberated Forsaken, answering Dillinger's call is a crucial way to prove your dedication to the Dark Lady and the defense of Tirisfal.
Deathguard commanders prize martial grit, so Dillinger's call tests your combat skill on the front line.
Answering defense calls from the Undercity strengthens solidarity between the Horde's Kalimdor allies and the newly integrated Forsaken.
